verdict.rationale: Kick documents managing multiple legal entities from a single workspace with each entity keeping its own books/reports and the ability to split shared expenses across entities (kick-docs-5, kick-docs-19, kick-docs-6), and pricing explicitly scales per-entity for unlimited entities (kick-supp-pricing). However, there is no evidence of a consolidated financial statement or roll-up report that combines P&L/Balance Sheet across entities into one view — reports appear to remain per-entity. Missing for 10: documented consolidated P&L/Balance Sheet output across entities, inter-entity elimination handling, and any cross-entity reporting UI/export.
